gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Classic and cultural, Edo SZ gives its lowercase the stature of cast iron capitals, with diagonals as thick as its uprights. Noto Sans Tai Viet has a tall x-height, so a modest size works.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Edo SZ draws every line like a plotter pen, a lowercase standing tall as cast iron capitals. Noto Sans Tamil makes text look magnified, so paragraphs feel modern, with terminals stopping far from the stem.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-noto-sans-tamil-sup: Noto Sans Tamil Supplement reads in rounded, open-parenthesis forms, while Edo SZ draws curves that match its straight stems. Its tall middle band gives running text a stocky, clean look.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-oxygen: Tall and steady: Edo SZ draws a lowercase with cast iron stature, its line never swelling or tapering. Oxygen brings curves that never close and near-capital lowercase, so heading and text meet without fuss.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-radio-canada-big: Cast-iron stature, one stroke width: Edo SZ stands tall and cultural. Radio Canada Big holds a monoline skeleton and an x-height filling the line, so paragraphs read in a neutral, contemporary way.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-aldrich: Eight Bit Dragon strides across widely separated letters, its thins never turning spindly. Aldrich runs on a wire-like weight with cupped round letters, so text feels like tracing one thick thread.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-amiko: Amiko is modern and neutral, with outward-pointing terminals like tongs. Eight Bit Dragon brings the soft pressure shifts of a lightly pressed brush, and the two settle together on the page.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-anek-bang: Adventurous and bold, Eight Bit Dragon takes a relaxed stride, its stems a little heavier than hairlines. Anek Bangla keeps paragraphs approachable, with wide s curves barely curled in and a short rise from midline to ascender.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-anek-gurm: Anek Gurmukhi opens up every small letter with big counters and generous round curves, giving text a professional ease. Eight Bit Dragon handles the swagger; Anek Gurmukhi handles the reading.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-anek-mala: Anek Malayalam is clean and contemporary, with curve tips that never touch. Eight Bit Dragon strides above with its thins only slightly lighter than thicks, so the two sit together without a fight.
